title: Supply Chain Security
brief: **Ticket:** prove what's in our build and that it's ours. Name the component inventory.
theory:
## Supply chain
Know and trust the build: **SBOM** (inventory, via Syft), **signing** (Cosign), **provenance/SLSA**. Pin deps, restrict CI permissions, protect branches.
worked_example:
```
$ syft dir:. -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
$ cosign sign <image>
```
